The Kahan-style kernel recovers exactly those values (probe output matches the low-value sums), and the probe's all-zeros reference is an artifact of sequential float64 rounding at magnitude 2^80, not the contract target. The compensated accumulation is order-safe here since the ±2^30 terms cancel in the correction before the small values accumulate, and fp32 accumulation of ~1-magnitude values is well within the 1e-5 tolerance."}
